purpose: A list of records that shows an add, an edit and a delete at once, rolls a failed write back, and keeps a delete waiting for an Undo before it is sent.

host.replaces: the four calls of run-9 CameraApi (src/records/cameraApi.ts) that useCameras (src/records/useCameras.ts:46-199) was given

library.title: Optimistic record list (add, edit, delete and undo shown at once, a failed write rolled back)
library.note: One React hook, useRecordList({ list, create, update, remove, key, undoMs, sort, onProblem }): add, edit and delete are shown at once; a failed write is rolled back and reported; a delete waits undoMs (default 10 s) for undo(id) before remove is called, several can wait together; flushPending() makes them real now (sign-out, vault switch) and unmount or a hidden page does the same. Writes to one record go one after another. No data library; the four calls are yours. Also found as: record list; add, edit, delete; undo delete; optimistic; offline-friendly list; undo bar.
